critiques.subject: Two water towers silhouetted at dusk with a blue twilight sky and city lights
improvements: [MODERATE] Lift midtones/shadows selectively on the towers and support structure (mask the towers; increase Shadows about +20 to +35 and slightly raise Exposure +0.2 to +0.4 only within the mask) while keeping the ground silhouette mostly dark
[MODERATE] Reduce sky noise and smooth the twilight gradient (apply luminance noise reduction ~20–35 and a light color NR ~20; consider masking NR to the sky to preserve structure sharpness)

[SUBTLE] Tame bright point lights and the red beacon bloom (lower Highlights/Whites slightly; use a small radial mask on the red light to reduce Exposure -0.2 to -0.5 and Highlights -20 to -40; optional mild dehaze +2 to +5 around the beacon only)
[MODERATE] Refine composition with a slight crop from the bottom (remove ~10–20% of the very dark foreground) and optionally a small left trim to reduce the large tree’s visual weight
[SUBTLE] Add controlled local contrast/clarity to the towers (Texture +10 to +20, Clarity +5 to +10, slight S-curve in midtones) and apply output sharpening with masking
preserve: The twilight blue-hour color and gradient in the sky
The overall moody silhouette/industrial atmosphere
critiques.notes: Strong blue-hour scene with pleasing silhouettes and a compelling industrial subject. The main gains will come from selectively opening the towers for detail while keeping the foreground dark, then cleaning up sky noise and controlling light bloom for a more polished finish.

improvements_detailed.action: Lift midtones/shadows selectively on the towers and support structure (mask the towers; increase Shadows about +20 to +35 and slightly raise Exposure +0.2 to +0.4 only within the mask) while keeping the ground silhouette mostly dark
improvements_detailed.reason: Reveals industrial detail and texture in the main subjects without destroying the intended dusk silhouette mood.

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce sky noise and smooth the twilight gradient (apply luminance noise reduction ~20–35 and a light color NR ~20; consider masking NR to the sky to preserve structure sharpness)
improvements_detailed.reason: The sky shows visible noise/grain and banding-like texture that distracts from the clean dusk atmosphere.

improvements_detailed.action: Tame bright point lights and the red beacon bloom (lower Highlights/Whites slightly; use a small radial mask on the red light to reduce Exposure -0.2 to -0.5 and Highlights -20 to -40; optional mild dehaze +2 to +5 around the beacon only)
improvements_detailed.reason: Controls clipping and glow so attention stays on the towers rather than hotspots.

improvements_detailed.action: Refine composition with a slight crop from the bottom (remove ~10–20% of the very dark foreground) and optionally a small left trim to reduce the large tree’s visual weight
improvements_detailed.reason: The heavy black foreground and dominant tree shapes pull attention away from the water towers; a tighter crop strengthens the subject emphasis.

improvements_detailed.action: Add controlled local contrast/clarity to the towers (Texture +10 to +20, Clarity +5 to +10, slight S-curve in midtones) and apply output sharpening with masking
improvements_detailed.reason: Enhances structural definition and separation against the sky without making the image look over-processed.
